methodology.population: one synthetic content template with independent UUIDs; original 52 retained only in isolated copy
methodology.setup: one G2 synthetic import followed by SQL metadata expansion; expansion is not G2 import throughput
methodology.query: alternating all-match capacitytoken and no-match absentcapacityneedle
methodology.limitations: single host, duplicate-content distribution, no remote network; sample count limits tail estimates

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX idx_question_revision_filters ON teachbase_app.question_revision USING btree (workspace_id, review_status, subject, stage, grade, question_type, difficulty_stars)

CREATE INDEX idx_question_revision_search_trgm ON teachbase_app.question_revision USING gin (lower((((((((((((((((((((((COALESCE(title, ''::character varying))::text || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(subject, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(stage, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(grade, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(question_type, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(lesson, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(primary_knowledge_tag, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(material_markdown, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(stem_markdown, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(answer_markdown, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(analysis_markdown, ''::text))) teachbase_app.gin_trgm_ops)

CREATE INDEX idx_question_revision_search_vector ON teachbase_app.question_revision USING gin (to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, (((((((((((((((((((((COALESCE(title, ''::character varying))::text || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(subject, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(stage, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(grade, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(question_type, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(lesson, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(primary_knowledge_tag, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(material_markdown, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(stem_markdown, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(answer_markdown, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(analysis_markdown, ''::text))))
CREATE INDEX idx_question_workspace_status ON teachbase_app.question USING btree (workspace_id, status, updated_at DESC, question_id)
